search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows _sourceName=Security (1102 or 517) ("EventCode = 1102;" or "EventCode = 517;")
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id | parse "Computer = \"*\";" as host nodrop | parse "ComputerName = \"*\";" as host nodrop | parse regex "Message = \"(?<msg_summary>[^\r\.]+?)(?:\r|\.|\";)" nodrop | parse "User = \"*\"" as src_user nodrop 
| where event_id in ("1102", "517")
| fields event_id, msg_summary, src_user, host
